business_problem: HKE Holdings , a listed fintech group focused on the Asia-Pacific region, established Hong Kong BGE Limited (HKBGE) to offer digital asset trading solutions for both retail and professional investors.
solution_summary: HKBGE is establishing a compliant and trusted virtual asset trading platform for clients to transact and trade virtual assets together with the company's secure custody services. To personalize responses to customers' questions, HKBGE collaborated with AWS to create a generative AI chatbot based on Meta's Llama 2 large language model. The chatbot, powered by Amazon EC2 G5 instances with NVIDIA A10G Tensor Core GPUs, is expected to deliver a better customer onboarding experience, providing thousands of personalized responses daily. Furthermore, HKBGE anticipates reducing support costs by 70 percent, freeing up resources to invest in staff training and tailored customer service. Since the license application in 2021, HKBGE has collaborated extensively with Amazon Web Services (AWS) on the development of its trading platform.

solution_components.name: Llama 2
solution_components.role: Provides the open language model used by the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Executes serverless processing and workflow glue for the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon GuardDuty
solution_components.role: Monitors threats and security signals around the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Inspector
solution_components.role: Assesses the workload posture supporting the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Detective
solution_components.role: Helps investigate security events tied to the customer and agent support workflows.
